description:
Open the guide to one of these less common capabilities: how to go about it, then its tools with their input schemas.
- captcha: get past a “verify you are human” check: reCAPTCHA, hCaptcha, Turnstile (Chromium browsers only)
- theming: measure the colours and contrast a page paints, and retheme it: dark mode, easier on the eyes
- diagnostics: read the console errors, exceptions and failed requests behind a page that misbehaves (Chromium browsers only)
- monitoring: watch a long upload, build or deploy and tell the user when it ends, or come back to something later on a timer
- downloads: make the page download a file and keep it, and list the files kept so far
- drag: drag one thing onto another: reorder a list, move a card, pull a slider, draw on a canvas

name.description: The capability whose guide to open.
